title: Nice Nutty Slovakian Pork Back Ribs Skewers
description: A festive Slovakian dish featuring pork back ribs with a resinous and crumbly texture, made with coconut cream crack and flexitarian friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for special occasions and outdoor gatherings.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, cracked black pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika, brown sugar, salt, and olive oil.
Add the pork back ribs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork back ribs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 20-25 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with additional coconut cream crack on the side, if desired.
